name: 14-merge-messages-tools-and-single
description: The two options that change what the caller's array looks like independently of strict. `tools:true`: a `tool` turn keeps its role (:869-871), keeps tool_calls and keeps tool_call_id (:887-890), and the squash pass refuses to merge it because the role test at :895 excludes `tool` -- so the array keeps [assistant, tool, tool] verbatim. `single:true` is exercised by the companion fixture 15; this one is the tools-kept half, which the default fixture 12 (tools:false) does not cover. The `tool_call_id` key surviving is the sharpest signal here: a port that strips tool_calls but forgets tool_call_id, or that deletes them outside the `if (!tools)` guard, diverges on exactly this field.
